Ditto. There are more sustainable options still, but if we can get the majority to reuse 'single use' masks safely, that will already be a huge decrease in #COVID19 waste volume. It's the surgical axiom 'don't let perfection be the enemy of good'.
#sustainability #ClimateCrisis

@MsGanoosh I know! Like 3 zucchinis in a polystyrene tray, all wrapped in clear plastic wrap. Why not just display them in the boxes that they arrive from the farm in, and save all the packaging? #ClimateEmergency 🌏🌳
